sources.extractionNotes: PDF text layer read directly, no OCR. Table I and Table II transcribed by scripts/build-cross2002-records.py, which recomputes the derived columns the paper also prints (vx2, vx2/vx1, ey, R*omega2/vx2) and refuses to write a record if any of them disagrees. Table II trailing columns m, A and mS were read but are not part of the collision state contract.
sources.reviewer: automated column check in the extraction script; human review pending

datasets.description: Seeded synthetic impacts from the V1 model with a published truth. Exists so the pipeline can be exercised without inventing measurements.
referenceConditions: no air drag, no Magnus, no spin decay in the generator

datasets.description: Seven individual low-speed bounces of a zero-spin tennis ball: six typical single bounces from Table II (wood, emery paper, Rebound Ace at 20 and 45 degrees, 60 cm drop) and one fully specified bounce from Table I (emery, 20 degrees, 25 cm drop) that publishes per-component uncertainties.
referenceConditions: zero incident spin by experimental construction (vertical drop, no torque in flight)
flat laboratory surfaces at 20 and 45 degrees to the incident direction
incident speed 2.24 to 3.80 m/s, far below serve and rally speeds
dry, room temperature; temperature and humidity not stated
contact position not measured; normal measured by construction

splitRule: explicit splitAssignment fixed before fitting; a group absent from it falls back to SHA256(group) mod 5: 0 test, 1 validation, else train
notes: EMPIRICAL_DATA is LIMITED: seven published low-speed bounces (cross2002-tennis-ball-surfaces) plus a large labelled SYNTHETIC set. No in-house measurement, no high-speed data, no repeated-bounce statistics.

Coefficients belong to a ball-surface combination. The published records cover three different surfaces (wood, emery paper, Rebound Ace), so a fit trains on one combination and the other surfaces are held out as transfer groups, never merged into one profile.
The synthetic dataset is SOFTWARE verification only and must never be reported as a measurement.
Splits are fixed before fitting: emery 60 cm drop trains, emery 25 cm drop validates in-domain, wood and Rebound Ace are the held-out transfer test.
Adding more measured data: create the record file, register the source above with its access date and SHA-256, add the dataset entry, and fix the split assignment before any fitting.
